anya: FYI onboarding hit a weird failure during hf->redwood convert for a new community model. tokenizer fails to load, and chat templates are wrong after convert. suspect partial safetensors shard download + tempfile reuse.

matt: ugh, logs?

anya: paste: ```
Convert started: hf://community/gpt-small-variant@main
Downloading shard 0/3 -> /tmp/hf_dl.tmp
curl: (18) transfer closed with outstanding read data remaining
Downloaded 42MB of 210MB, wrote to /tmp/hf_dl.tmp
converter: checksum mismatch, attempting retry (rev pin: main -> falling back)
converter: opened /tmp/hf_dl.tmp as safetensors -> mmap error on header
Tokenizer load failed: missing <|sep|> special token in vocab
ChatTemplate default roles mismatch: system/user vs system/assistant
```

samir: that curl error is classic partial content. HF CDN sometimes returns 206 with a Content-Range and our downloader was trying to resume into the same tempfile. if retry truncates/resumes wrong, safetensors index gets corrupted.

julian: also seen config.json differences when rev resolves to a snapshot tag vs commit sha — chat templates can differ which explains role name mismatch. converter should pin exact commit when --rev given.

anya: current behaviour: --rev main tries to use hub API to resolve latest -> if hub auth 401 or flaky, we fallback to best-effort and use the first available index.json. that combined with partial shard makes a weird state.

matt: quick repro idea: simulate interrupted download and then run converter with --rev main and compare final .safetensors sizes. can we reproduce locally?

samir: repro'd quickly. downloader code uses a single tempfile path '/tmp/hf_dl.tmp'. concurrent retries just append, not atomically replace. i can see a race where retry writes overlapping bytes.

infra-bot: Incident created: #1423 - safetensors partial-download + tempfile reuse -> corrupted shard (assigned to samir).

julian: small patch: make downloader use unique tempfile per attempt (append PID+ts), verify sha256 before mmap, and on mismatch remove file entirely before retry. also, when --rev is not an exact sha, call hub api to pin commit and pass that commit to all subsequent hub requests.

anya: workaround for now: run converter with `--force-full-download --rev <commit-sha>` or set env HF_ALLOW_RANGE=false to force single-range fetch. that fixed my run.

samir: PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/convert-tool/pull/231
Changes: unique tempfiles, delete on checksum fail, pin rev resolution earlier. added unit test simulating curl 18.

matt: nice. any eval impact? the bot-run showed a small regen in chat-fmt because of pinning to a commit with a slightly different template. we should run the eval harness to make sure no quality regression.

anya: kicked off eval run against gold promptset. watching rouge/response-length/role-alignment.

julian: long term: add range-aware shard downloader that validates Content-Range and supports atomic replace. also make converter record source-revision in metadata so we can trace mismatches.

matt: rolled the hotfix to staging CLI at 2069001400, will promote to prod if evals are green. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

anya: filed followups: issue #1424 (chat-template regression monitoring), #1425 (add metadata to converted models).
